longest: Form an independent Commission including members from Labor Welfare Department and Police Department to administer the welfare of journalists including revise the Press regulations; to provide skills training; to settle disputes between the management and workers; settle disputes between public, press and police; to decide pension related disputes; and to increase the amount of family welfare fund.

Construct a Dravidian Movement Dheerargal Kottam in Chennai in honor of tall leaders of the
Dravidian movement including Dr C Natesanar, Sir P Theyagarayar, Dr TM Nair who have fought for social justice
and equality for all in our state, because of which we have developed as one of the top states in India.

Create Agricultural Development Councils with farmer representatives to resolve conflicts in the agricultural sector, to plan new beneficial schemes for farmers and to fix a minimum support price (MSP) for farmer produce including but not limited to- bananas, turmeric, tapioca, dals, chilli, millets, tea, oil seeds, horticultural products, etc.

Urge the Central Govt to make necessary laws to grant Indian citizenship to the Tamil refugees from Sri Lanka that have been living in refugee camps for the last 30 years or so, and to also make arrangements for those willing to return to Sri Lanka.

Appoint 25000 women as community welfare workers who will act as liaison officers/ advocates that strengthen the capacity of govt officials to engage with citizens and ease communication between govt and the people, working in villages under the supervision of Block Development Officers (BDO).

Set-up a State level Water Management Scheme with a budget of 10,000 crore under the Chief Minister’s Monitorable Target to improve the livelihood of farmers, conserve the specified water bodies, build canals to store and distribute water, and support irrigation in all districts.

Govt Cooperative societies will support the livelihood of cottage industry workers and self-help groups through a direct procurement programme in Salem, Peravurani and Pattukottai districts, where coir products are mostly manufactured by micro and cottage industry workers, and women self-help groups.

Provide special financial assistance including subsidies to people who come forward to cultivate date palm trees (rich in iron) in the districts of Tuticorin, Vellore, Karur and Dharmapuri where the soil is found to be highly conducive to date palm cultivation.

Establish a new Ministry for Water Resources to work alongside the Public Works Department to study the cause and impact of recent natural calamities including floods, drought, and such like; how to optimise the water resources and distribution across the state.

Pass Right to Skill Training Act to provide skill training and to ensure a job or self-employment opportunity for children who were abandoned by their parents, abandoned transgender people, persons with special needs who are unable to go to regular school.

longest: Provide interest-free loans up to 1,000 rupees payable in easy installments to ensure financial service and to repay loans obtained from private lenders at high interest, structured to be repaid at the level of 10 rupees per week, and provide Amma Banking Card service to use for all bank transactions, paying all fees, and getting all government services.

Increase the financial assistance provided under the scheme of giving financial assistance to unemployed youth registered in employment office to 300 rupees for those who completed 10th standard, 400 rupees for those who completed 12th standard, and 600 rupees for graduates.

Take appropriate action against those responsible for the genocide of Sri Lankan Tamils and continuously take measures to ensure that Sri Lankan Tamils live with full freedom and self-respect, and to achieve a separate Tamil Eelam.

Provide skill development trainings to young men and young women to pave the way for them to get jobs and self-employ themselves, and set up training centers for this purpose in panchayat unions and urban areas.
Provide trainings to 10 lakh persons through industries and take action for them to get jobs in those same companies, with the government itself bearing the cost for this training.

Provide loan assistance at low interest through Tamil Nadu Backward Classes Economic Development Corporation for backward classes, most backward classes and denotified communities to start small businesses and trade.
Provide 1 liter of Aavin milk fortified with Vitamin A, Vitamin D, and iron at a low price of Rs 25 to nurture the welfare of women and children.
Establish 'Amma Two Wheeler Repair Training Centre' in all panchayat unions and provide short term training, and provide assistance to start self-employment for those who received this training.
Implement a new special scheme at a cost of 800 crore rupees to cut down and remove old and pest-attacked coconut trees and plant new coconut saplings.
Take appropriate action after receiving the report regarding the demand to increase the reservation provided for backward Muslims, which has been sent to the Backward Classes Commission.

longest: Include other major projects such as the Anaimalaiyar - Nallar linkage project (Tiruppur/Coimbatore), Erthalav - Pulikarai linkage project (Dharmapuri), construction of check dams and barrage dams in the Cauvery and Thirumanimutharu parts of Namakkal district, Upper Vaipar and Mudangiyar river restoration (Virudhunagar/Rajapalayam), Ramnathi - Jambunathi linkage canal project (Tenkasi/Alangulam), and Tamirabarani - Karumeniyar - Nambiyar linkage project (Tirunelveli/Thoothukudi) in this.

Exert genuine and emotional pressure on the Union government to take appropriate measures to recover and retain the traditional fishing rights of Indian and Tamil Nadu fishermen in the Gulf of Mannar in accordance with the Katchatheevu agreement between the Indian and Sri Lankan governments.

Provide opportunities for registered folk artists to showcase their artistic skills in government festivals and events to ensure they get at least one hundred days of employment a year, and grant financial assistance of 15 thousand rupees to help them purchase necessary instruments.

Create an integrated disaster management office in all 38 districts, flood prevention infrastructure in 5 coastal cities including Chennai, and dedicated disaster management offices for heatwaves in all 38 districts to undertake tasks ranging from predicting local heatwaves to conducting immediate medical check-ups.

Reduce the electricity bill of 30 lakh urban apartment residents by replacing 18 thousand old transformers, reducing AT&C losses from 16% to 10% through a time-of-day tariff system, and collecting residential tariff instead of the currently charged commercial tariff in apartment common areas.

Distribute iron and folic acid-fortified rice, vitamin A and vitamin D-enriched cooking oil, and fortified wheat flour to everyone through ration shops to prevent public suffering from anemia, vitamin A, and B-12 deficiencies, thereby creating a healthy Tamil Nadu without nutritional deficiencies.

Take measures to increase the production of A2 milk obtained exclusively from our native cows through Aavin, to increase the production of food products made from it such as ghee, cheese, and ice cream, and to market them in a quality manner.

Tabulate the Education and Medicine Equal Opportunity Budget for eliminating quality differences between educational institutions and hospitals in towns and villages, immediately filling teacher, doctor, and nurse vacancies, world-class education for all children, and world-class medicine for all members of the public.

Provide cash prizes of 6 crore rupees to Tamil Nadu athletes who win a gold medal in the Olympic games, 4 crore rupees for those who win a silver medal, and 3 crore rupees for those who win a bronze medal.

Provide incentives and subsidies along with infrastructure facilities for ten years to those investing for Thoothukudi to serve as a green ammonia filling centre for international ships, as part of the plan to make Thoothukudi the premier port in South Asia.
